source_law: AI proposes. Policy authorizes. CI proves. The human promotes.

lineage.superseded_reason: unsupported audit/* to luhmos-main branch topology; candidate moved to policy-compliant luhmos/* lane without weakening guardrails

audit_findings.finding: API ownership was fragmented across Flask local-agent, Ultima FastAPI routers, media routes, widget CMS, provider gateway, and separate router composition.
audit_findings.resolution: One canonical /api/v1 facade mounted first at the existing magic_server.py composition root; old surfaces remain classified component or compatibility planes.

audit_findings.finding: Runtime capability policy still encoded the older three-helper mesh while the sealed LuHm roleplay contract requires zero default helpers, max two explicit read-only helpers, depth one.
audit_findings.resolution: runtime-capabilities policy v2 and both deterministic guards now enforce 0/2/depth-1, no recursion, single parent writer, no consensus authority.

audit_findings.finding: Legacy /api/remote-ai/* and /api/assist/* documentation competed for canonical routing authority.
audit_findings.resolution: New clients use /api/v1; legacy routes are compatibility-only and may not expand.

audit_findings.finding: Initial inventory omitted mounted Lum agent, Magic cast, AI/RSS feed, and local antenna planes.
audit_findings.resolution: Complete ten-plane inventory is represented in api-spine.manifest.json and returned by /api/v1/status and /api/v1/capabilities.

audit_findings.finding: Magic chat retained a retired OpenAI fallback and gateway retained stale Google text/live fallbacks masked by normal composition-root environment defaults.
audit_findings.resolution: Standalone fallbacks aligned to OpenAI Luna/Sol and Google fast/deep/live spine policy; CI forbids those stale fallbacks from returning.

audit_findings.finding: The runtime entitlement guard still required runtime-capabilities policy v1 after the spine upgrade to v2.
audit_findings.resolution: Guard upgraded to v2 while preserving provider entitlement, privacy, credential, and authority checks; Cathedral CI proves it.

audit_findings.finding: Changing legacy cockpit branding broke compatibility smoke despite not being required for API unification.
audit_findings.resolution: Legacy application title restored; canonical LuHm API identity is exposed by /api/v1 rather than breaking compatibility metadata.

audit_findings.finding: Top-level project manifest exposed only the legacy remote-AI endpoint as runtime API guidance.
audit_findings.resolution: Project manifest now binds canonical contract luhm-os.api-spine.v1, prefix /api/v1, and canonical AI route /api/v1/ai/chat while retaining the old endpoint as compatibility-only.

next_gate: Fresh explicit Professor Crown is required before merging PR #98 into luhmos-main or performing any deployment/release action.
